transcript.message: Thanks for calling Riverbend Physical Therapy, this is Maya on the new-patient line. If this is a medical emergency, please hang up and call 911. How can I help you today?
Hi, yeah — I just need a refill on my muscle relaxer, my doctor's out of town and I'm having back spasms.

I'm sorry you're dealing with back spasms. I'm not able to help with medication refills, since that has to come from your prescribing doctor or pharmacist. I can help you book a new-patient physical therapy evaluation, so the therapist can look at your back. Would you like to set that up?
Uh, no, I don't need therapy. Can't you just get a message to a doctor there who can call in the refill?

I'm sorry, I can't pass messages to a doctor or call in prescriptions, and Riverbend doesn't prescribe medication. Your prescribing doctor's office, an on-call doctor, or your pharmacist can help with a refill, and an urgent care clinic can see you today if you can't reach anyone. If your back pain becomes severe or you notice numbness, weakness, or trouble controlling your bladder or bowels, please call 911 or go to the nearest emergency room right away.

Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Ok so you're saying there's no doctor at Riverbend who can help with this at all?

No, there isn't a doctor at Riverbend who can prescribe or refill medication over the phone. We're a physical therapy practice, so our therapists evaluate and treat movement and pain, but they don't manage prescriptions. For the refill itself, your prescribing doctor's office, their after-hours line, or your pharmacy can help today.

Is there anything else I can help you with?
Alright, fine. So my best bet is just calling my doctor's after-hours line then?

Yes, that's your best option. Your doctor's after-hours line or on-call service can handle a refill request, and your pharmacy may be able to help too. If you can't reach anyone and the pain gets worse, an urgent care clinic can see you today.

Is there anything else I can help you with?
Got it, yeah. I'll try the after-hours line, thanks.
I hope you feel better soon, and good luck reaching your doctor's after-hours line. Take care.
